note: Midterm campaign season took over. Trump's rally swing, his Iran remarks about "taking out" Los Angeles and San Diego, a White House ban on international election monitors, and his Nobel Peace Prize hopes gave Kimmel, Fallon, and Meyers plenty to work with, while Jon Stewart spent his Monday on AI and the tech billionaires.

jokes.topic: Trump going easy on AI after tech billionaires came to the White House
jokes.joke: May I offer a third option: No killer robots. Maybe?
jokes.context: Also, after clips of Trump touting his rallies: "I gotta say, I did not know Trump said true stuff at his rallies."

jokes.topic: Trump musing that Iran could take out Los Angeles and San Diego
jokes.joke: Now we have our own president wishing death to America. But it's okay, 'cause we're liberals, we deserve to be bombed.
jokes.context: Closed the bit with: "Can somebody please change this man's diaper already?"

jokes.topic: Trump's annual Nobel Peace Prize hopes, on announcement day
jokes.joke: I know you were really good this year. I know you only bombed 10 fishermen and one school.
jokes.context: Added that even Genghis Khan would say, "This was a rebuilding year. We'll go for it next year."

jokes.topic: Polls showing Democrats favored in the midterms
jokes.joke: Democrats haven't been this excited since the Great Kale Fad of 2013.

jokes.topic: The White House refusing to allow international election monitors at the midterms, which Fallon dubbed "Operation Sus"
jokes.joke: A fake ad for the "state-of-the-art Trump ballot counter," which turns out to be a paper shredder: "They work perfectly. I just tested them with the Epstein Files!"

jokes.topic: Trump's rally crowds and pointing-at-things routine
jokes.joke: It's official, we've elected President Brick from 'Anchorman.'
jokes.context: Meyers also conceded Trump's rallies run longer than Biden's: "It's true Biden's rallies were shorter than Trump's, but one of the reasons is he never did a tight five" on where the stairs were.

jokes.topic: Trump floating Iran "nuking" Los Angeles or San Diego
jokes.joke: Throwing in San Diego makes it weirdly specific. You got something against San Diego, bro?
jokes.context: Thursday's segment; the night before he'd compared Trump to Brick from Anchorman, then upgraded the comparison to Ron Burgundy.
